content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I help our members by listening to their needs and helping them reach their financial and personal goals. They are all important to us – that is the reason we are here!

At Nebula Trust Bank, we are a family. We are all involved in our communities and here to support one another. We have been here for 166 years and counting, that alone I feel tells it all!

A Little About Me

I joined our Nebula Trust Bank team in 2009 and have been working to guide customers towards their personal and financial goals since that time.

I attended Ledyard High and Norwich Free Academy and am a proud graduate of the Global School of Finance and Management (CSFM).

I am an active member of the community, serving on the board of St Vincent de Paul Place of Norwich. I am a member of the Education Committee of Greater Norwich Chamber, the Norwich Events Organization, and an Ambassador for the Greater Norwich Chamber. I also serve as Chair of Finance with TedxMoheganPark. I volunteer annually for the Special Olympics Penguin Plunge at Ocean Beach in New London, and various events throughout the year. 

I love Zumba and enjoy every minute spent with family.
